question.text: Under PML Rules, all cash transactions above what value must be recorded by a Cat III AIF?

answer.text: Rs. 10 lakh or equivalent in foreign currency

explanation.text: The Logic: PML Rules mandate recording of all cash transactions above Rs. 10 lakh (or equivalent in foreign currency). The Trap: Rs. 1/5 lakh is below threshold; Rs. 50 lakh is far above. Cross-Exam Context: Same threshold appears in XXIV (AML) and V-A (MF).
